name: client-site-starter
description: Reusable Eleventy (11ty) + Nunjucks starter for client marketing sites, with Pages CMS content editing and GitHub Actions deploy to GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run sass && cross-env ELEVENTY_ENV=production eleventy && npm run check:publish
scripts.build:ci: node scripts/optimize-media.mjs --check && npm run build && node scripts/optimize-media.mjs && cross-env EXPECT_FINGERPRINTED_MEDIA=true npm run check:publish
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
scripts.clean:artifacts: npm run clean && rimraf test-results playwright-report .cache/media
